entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Blazor wasm standalone hot reload not working #120621
  • Race Condition in StaticWebAssets with Multi-Targeting and TypeScript Compilation #120620
  • StreamPipeReader.ReadAtLeastAsyncCore should not allocate such large buffers #120618
  • Thread safety issue in STJ.JsonObject #120617
  • [android] failed to build android on macos #120616

Closed

  • Regex should fail to parse "^*" #29174
    Future
  • System.Tests.Perf_DateTime.GetNow gets slower every summer due to daylight savings #67932
    Future
  • Performance Regression in Concurrent (Stack/Queue)? #61673
    Future
  • StreamReader.ReadLineAsync performance can be improved #62061
    Future
  • System.Numerics.BigInteger: use LastIndexOfAnyExcept (when relevant) #84855

    Future
